scope: Finish global Loading / Toast brand unification without flattening content, media or persistent states into blocking Toasts
result: All existing business Loading and transient Toasts retain their single shared branded host. Previously plain media/content pending states now reuse BrandProgressMark at the original location. Received introductions have one feedback source; call blocking uses the correct operation caption.

coverage.existing_business: App/Auth/Event/Profile/Coin wrappers → ActionLoading → one BrandToastHost; private chat keeps inline brand progress
coverage.toast: Success/info/warning/error retain the top-centered translucent card, gradient fine edge, correct state icon, auto-dismiss and manual close
coverage.no_legacy: Source and native-host audit found no remaining native/default Toast or business spinner; convention checks now reject common native APIs, default vendor tags and legacy skins
coverage.deduplication: One received-introduction Toast for error && !sheet; Sheet errors remain persistent within their context
coverage.caption: Waiting-call block shows Blocking account…; ending/reporting keeps Ending call…

preserved: All pre-existing worktree edits preserved; no staging/commit/push/reset
400–600ms write delay (default500),600ms skeleton and3s carousel unchanged
Header/Tabbar/safe-area ownership and warm card cursor retained
Dedicated skeleton/refresh/filter/startup/matching/coin state designs retain their roles
Photo Retry, audio failure, permissions, atomic rollback and Store/media ownership unchanged
No new Discover entrance design, fake delivery/review/payment, service or physical microphone request

verification.status: Passed: complete global feedback checks, browser media/content cases and selected WKWebView regression

browser.real_media: Real supplied MP3 decoding and IndexedDB/media paths; controlled resource-read delay only. No extra application delay or production testing hook.

verification.warnings: No convention/browser warnings. Existing Xcode AppIntents metadata-skipped warning and simulator WebKit/Accessibility diagnostics.
recovered_test_issues: The built Toast controller is internal; tests map the actual exported show_toast wrapper from the exact build rather than requiring a production test export.
The native test loader previously removed every 'export ' substring, corrupting toast_export = ''. It now strips only anchored function-export declarations; a regression protects explicit arguments.
limits: New delayed media pending states are exercised in the browser; native selected tests cover shared style, four Toast tones, system Loading and guarded business operations, not physical camera/microphone/photo permissions.
Broad whole-app acceptance is not claimed by this targeted feedback regression.
